newsitem.title: USA: Clinton offers CEA job to Yellen - admin official.
newsitem.headline: Clinton offers CEA job to Yellen - admin official.

text.p: President Clinton has offered the chairmanship of his Council of Economic Advisers to Federal Reserve Board Governor Janet Yellen, an administration official said Thursday.
"He's decided on her," the official said. "In fact, she's the only one he met with" to discuss the job, he added.
Earlier, White House sources said Yellen was likely to be nominated to chair the CEA, which does economic analysis for the president. She would have to be confirmed by the Senate.
Joseph Stiglitz is resigning as CEA chairman to become chief economist at the World Bank.
On Wednesday incoming White House Chief of Staff Erskine Bowles said Clinton was likely to make some Cabinet appointments on Friday.
